scope: Read-only final source, method and byte-binding acceptance. These are eleven bounded review/integrity groups, not a rerun of numerical tests or a new browser session.

checks.label: Final independent QA receipt records 612 passing checks
All 85 completed-download records have nonempty bytes and SHA-256
Final QA records no errors, missing local resources or implicit external requests
No product files changed during the final QA run
All 446 product-file hashes still match the final QA manifest
Serialized product manifest matches the receipt and final binding
Final receipt and browser-driver bytes match the recorded binding
Round 4 and Round 5 reviewed product manifests are identical
Seven held search implementation/test/UI hashes remain unchanged
Final independent browser acceptance includes selected search semantics at all four widths
Nine examples remain date-only, unvalenced and linked to qualified institutional source metadata

reviewedSemantics: Exact civil daily samples and clock/range resolution before prefilters; no continuous-time or whole-day conclusion.
Rank retains all-window top-K by a single named tradition/class, with unknown-rule denominator and incompleteness preserved.
Runtime calendar-field absence, fold/gap failures and unavailable rule outcomes remain distinct; descriptive paired/pooled denominators are explicit.
Shared lunar inputs, duplicate/control overlap, convenience selection and post-selection bias remain disclosed; no probability, independent confirmation or causal forecast is inferred.
Worker cancellation cannot emit stale success; source imports stay unverified and birth inputs are excluded from public search exports.
limits: No new full-range 73414-date brute run, external ephemeris validation, statistical outcome validation, provider call, physical-phone test or screen-reader test was performed in this review.
Source reading remains the selected institutional passages recorded in the source ledger; this is not full-book reading or new religious/calendar authority.
Deployment, repository-wide commit binding and remote CI are moderator gates.
